verdict.rationale: Groq is a hosted model inference provider, so a model deprecation policy is a fair question to ask of it. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions deprecation schedules, advance notice, or model removal. The models page only describes current models such as GPT-OSS 120B and says nothing about retirement timelines.

support.subject: As a developer, I can rely on a documented deprecation policy with advance notice before a hosted model is removed
